description: Captures the reference effect of triggering an E1M1 use-line (the first switch or door): scripted forward movement to the door at the start of the level then a single USE press. State snapshot hashes at the USE press and at the end of the door open animation must reflect the door's sector floor/ceiling thinker plus the player's facing angle. Initial entries empty pending external reference run.
captureMethod: From 02-020 spawn, scripted forward burst, turn to the door, press USE per default.cfg key_use = 57 (SPACE), wait ~70 tics for door open animation, capture state at the USE press tic, USE press + 1, and USE press + 70.
